You&#8217;ll have access to the swimming pool, as well as to the campsite&#8217;s activities and services.</p></div></div><div class="buttons"><a href="https://acampa-vacances.com/en/international/accommodation/#villas" rel="noreferrer noopener" class="buttons__btn">Discover</a></div></div></div><div class="columns__item card-heb"><div class="gallery"><figure class="gallery__item"><picture><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Terrasse-vue-mer-piscine-420x420.jpg.webp" media="(max-width: 210px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Terrasse-vue-mer-piscine-850x566.jpg.webp" media="(max-width: 420px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Terrasse-vue-mer-piscine-768x511.jpg.webp" media="(max-width: 850px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Terrasse-vue-mer-piscine-1024x682.jpg.webp" media="(max-width: 1024px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Terrasse-vue-mer-piscine-scaled.jpg.webp" media="(min-width: 1025px)"><img decoding="async" src="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Terrasse-vue-mer-piscine-420x420.jpg.webp" width="420" height="210" loading="lazy" alt="Terrasse vue mer piscine" title="Home 15"></picture></figure></div><div class="group texte"><p class="h3">Apartments</p><p>The <strong>apartments</strong> range in size from 33 to 58m2 and can accommodate<strong> 2 to 5 people</strong>.</p><div class="lireplus fc-desk"><p>Read more</p><div class="group"><p>These types of rental accommodation are available as ground-floor apartments, duplex apartments with bedrooms, mezzanine apartments with an upper floor, or even with a private spa. To enhance your stay close to the beach, they feature a terrace or balcony so you can breathe in the sea air from your vacation rental.</p></div></div><div class="buttons"><a href="https://acampa-vacances.com/en/international/accommodation/#appartement" rel="noreferrer noopener" class="buttons__btn">Discover</a></div></div></div><div class="columns__item card-heb"><div class="gallery"><figure class="gallery__item"><picture><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/photo-villa-420x420.webp" media="(max-width: 210px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/photo-villa-850x685.webp" media="(max-width: 420px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/photo-villa-768x619.webp" media="(max-width: 850px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/photo-villa-1024x826.webp" media="(max-width: 1024px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/photo-villa.webp" media="(min-width: 1025px)"><img decoding="async" src="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/photo-villa-420x420.webp" width="420" height="210" loading="lazy" alt="photo villa" title="Home 16"></picture></figure></div><div class="group texte"><p class="h3">Mobile homes <span class="fc-span">with or without jacuzzi</span></p><p><strong>The comfortable mobile homes</strong> at the <strong>4-star International Giens campsite</strong> are functional models for up to 6 people.</p><div class="lireplus fc-desk"><p>Read more</p><div class="group"><p>Some have a <strong>private spa</strong> or a private terrace with garden furniture. Otherwise, inside, you&#8217;ll find all the comforts you need for a successful vacation in Provence Alpes Côte d&#8217;Azur. </p></div></div><div class="buttons"><a href="https://acampa-vacances.com/en/international/accommodation/#mobilhome" rel="noreferrer noopener" class="buttons__btn">Discover</a></div></div></div><div class="columns__item card-heb"><div class="gallery"><figure class="gallery__item"><picture><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/1DSC00055-1-420x420.jpg.webp" media="(max-width: 210px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/1DSC00055-1-850x568.jpg.webp" media="(max-width: 420px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/1DSC00055-1-768x513.jpg.webp" media="(max-width: 850px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/1DSC00055-1-1024x684.jpg.webp" media="(max-width: 1024px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/1DSC00055-1.jpg.webp" media="(min-width: 1025px)"><img decoding="async" src="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/1DSC00055-1-420x420.jpg.webp" width="420" height="210" loading="lazy" alt="1DSC00055 1" title="Home 17"></picture></figure></div><div class="group texte"><p class="h3"><span class="fc-span">Spacious, shady</span> pitches</p><p>Discover pitches offering all the space and comfort you need for a successful camping holiday.</p><div class="buttons"><a href="https://acampa-vacances.com/en/international/accommodation/#emplacement" rel="noreferrer noopener" class="buttons__btn">Discover</a></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<div class="group sec-20 fade-up align-full"><figure class="pinceaux"><picture><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/pinceaux-international-de-giens-420x420.webp" media="(max-width: 210px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/pinceaux-international-de-giens-567x850.webp" media="(max-width: 420px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/pinceaux-international-de-giens-768x1152.webp" media="(max-width: 850px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/pinceaux-international-de-giens-683x1024.webp" media="(max-width: 1024px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/pinceaux-international-de-giens.webp" media="(min-width: 1025px)"><img decoding="async" src="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/pinceaux-international-de-giens-420x420.webp" width="420" height="210" loading="lazy" alt="pinceaux international de giens" title="Home 18"></picture></figure><h2 class="inline">Discover our activities <span class="fc-span">on the Giens peninsula!</span></h2><p>Discover the fun and natural activities on the Presqu&#8217;île de Giens! From bike rides and hikes through Mediterranean landscapes to water sports like kayaking and paddleboarding, every moment is an adventure. Explore secret coves, observe local wildlife and let yourself be seduced by this unique natural gem.  </p><div class="gallery col-4 fc-diapo-mob" data-fancybox="gallery-mob"><figure
